Hi Samantha — thanks for sending the intake. Looping in Marissa (Procurement) and Jordan (FinOps) to align on payment path and PO mapping. Quick answers and next steps below.

What we need from you to finish onboarding:
- Completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (attached) — please confirm the exact legal name and EIN on page 2.
- Proof of bank account: either a recent bank statement PDF or a micro-deposit verification. We prefer micro-deposits for ACH activation, but will accept a bank statement for immediate wire setup.
- Remittance sample: a single-line CSV showing how you would like remittance to appear (invoice#, amount, PO# mapping). See our minimal remittance requirements below.

Remittance & PO guidance (to expedite auto-apply):
- Required fields on invoices: Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Invoice Amount, PO Number (exact match to our PO value)
- Recommended: include a single remittance email address in the invoice footer: billing@larkind.com
- Preferred PO format: PO-##### (we can accept other formats but let us know so routing rules can be updated)

Micro-deposit process (preferred for ACH):
1) We will initiate two micro-deposits (random cents) to the account you provide.
2) You reply with the two amounts and we mark ACH as verified.
3) Wire capability does not require micro-deposits; send wire beneficiary info and we can add the routing immediately.

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable) and a small remittance_csv_sample.csv with our expected header order. Once we receive either the micro-deposit confirmation or a bank statement, Procurement will finalize the vendor record and issue the first PO.

Next step: can you confirm whether you prefer micro-deposit or statement by end of day tomorrow? If micro-deposit, please reply with the exact account and routing numbers (we encrypt them in transit).

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Vendor Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference
